title: GEO agency landscape, September 2026
method: For each agency we opened its main GEO / AI search service page (or the homepage where the homepage is the GEO offer), removed navigation, footer and cookie text, and searched the remaining text for signals in eleven groups. Every hit was read in context; hits from cookie banners or unrelated text were discarded by hand. This measures what each agency says on its service page, not what it does for clients.

signals.repeatedRuns: Describes measuring with repeated runs, sample sizes, confidence intervals or probability of mention
signals.acknowledgesVariance: Says AI answers fluctuate or are non-deterministic
signals.publishedPricing: Publishes a price on the page
signals.agentic: Mentions agent readiness (agentic commerce, A2A endpoints, WebMCP, UCP, ACP)
signals.webmcpOrUcp: Mentions WebMCP or Google's Universal Commerce Protocol by name
signals.offsite: Mentions off-site work: Reddit, YouTube, digital PR, lists, review sites
signals.revenueLanguage: Talks about pipeline, revenue, conversion or attribution
signals.fasterThanMonthly: States a reporting or tracking cadence faster than monthly

agencies.name: Citevora
agencies.note: Service page rendered about 145 words of text; entity and knowledge-graph work is listed as a separate service. Copilot recommended this agency first in our AI Answer Audit.

agencies.name: WebFX
agencies.note: Publishes a starting price per month, prompt-volume tiers, monthly performance scoring and real-time monitoring across 10 LLM platforms.

agencies.name: iPullRank
agencies.note: Digital PR, review sites, entity work, revenue attribution.

agencies.name: NoGood
agencies.note: Lists agentic commerce optimisation; real-time monitoring through its own platform; YouTube, digital PR and earned media.

agencies.name: Powered by Search
agencies.note: FAQ states no credible agency can guarantee deterministic inclusion. Lists, review sites, digital PR, entity, schema, pipeline.

agencies.name: Foundation
agencies.note: Reddit, YouTube, digital PR; weekly tracking of key metrics; pipeline and attribution language.

agencies.name: Omniscient Digital
agencies.note: YouTube, digital PR, entity work, pipeline and revenue language.

agencies.name: WebFlur
agencies.note: Positions on A2A agentic endpoints; states first citations in 30–60 days and compound gains over 3–6 months; offers a 30-day deployment guarantee.

agencies.name: Veza Digital
agencies.note: Says AI citations fluctuate daily and a one-time check is misleading; publishes audit and retainer prices; audit includes 30 days of tracking across six engines.

agencies.name: First Page Sage
agencies.note: GEO page rendered about 500 words; the site runs many industry-specific SEO + GEO pages.

agencies.name: Go Fish Digital
agencies.note: YouTube, digital PR, earned media, entity, schema; publishes a GEO whitepaper and a lead-generation case study.

agencies.name: Siege Media
agencies.note: Positions as a full-service GEO agency with industry-specific GEO pages; Reddit and digital PR.
